proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our block heater cord was cracked right at the grille and I hadn't noticed. They swapped it with the battery test in October and the car started at minus twenty in January.
reviews.name: Erik S.

reviews.text: A frost heave on Northern Lights knocked my steering wheel crooked. They found a bent tie rod, replaced it, aligned it, and showed me the bent one on the bench.
reviews.name: Lena P.

reviews.text: The defroster barely cleared a spot on the windshield on dark mornings. It was a stuck blend door, not the heater core another shop priced. Clear glass on the Glenn now.
reviews.name: Marcus O.

reviews.text: Booked the stud swap early in the window and was in and out of the waiting room by lunch. They pointed out one tire with low tread and said it would last one more winter.
reviews.name: Gail T.

reviews.text: Before driving to Denali they found a soft upper hose and a nail in the spare. Small things, but that road is a long way from anywhere.
reviews.name: Tomas R.

reviews.text: Clipped a moose's back leg near Girdwood. They checked the radiator, the headlight mounts and the bumper supports, and told me what could wait until the insurance check came.
reviews.name: Jenna K.

proof.guarantee: We tell you what can wait until next season, and we never fix it without your yes.
